bibl.title: Benefactions toward Temples in the Ptolemaic Fayum.
bibl.seg: Joanna Wilimowska, Benefactions toward Temples in the Ptolemaic Fayum.
bibl.note: Provides an updated list of benefactions toward temples in the Fayum and investigates their function and significance in the temples' life within the broader Ptolemaic society.
